summary: First-party English and Portuguese discovery evidenced the municipal Finance Secretariat as local real-estate-cadastre custodian and GeoMacaé as the official municipal GIS. Anonymous inspection of the current portal and map pages found thematic map/PDF/Google My Maps products but no safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response, schema, CRS, or qualified citywide parcel layer. No GeoJSON sample is retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries and bounded official endpoint checks are recorded in city-8138-maca.json, including HTTP 200 portal/map responses and the absence of a qualified parcel feature endpoint.
custodians: Prefeitura Municipal de Macaé / Secretaria Municipal de Fazenda / Coordenadoria de Lançamento Imobiliário
GeoMacaé / Secretaria Municipal de Planejamento e Gestão
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point was preserved and not moved.

qualification.reason: Local cadastral custody and official GIS are evidenced, but no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response, schema, CRS, or public citywide parcel coverage was qualified.

uncertainty: GeoMacaé may have additional interactive/provider-backed resources not exposed in bounded HTML inspection; the current public parcel API and native identity semantics remain unresolved.
